name: The Fen Diggers Day Event
description:
New 18 acre field at floral farm
Surrounding fields have produced some really good finds including many gold and plenty of hammered, the field next door produced a silver annular brooch
Hoping this one is as good, never been on this field before
Parking will be on the hard standing track which will then be a 30 second walk to the field
Unfortunately this will be the last midweek this year
Capped at 30 people this one. £20 Per-person
